name: fideliy
description: A modern loyalty and rewards platform built for Tunisian SMBs, enabling merchants to create stamp cards, issue points, and manage customer rewards through a web dashboard.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --cwd backend && npm install --cwd frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
